description: SSO-4120 — this application's PRODUCTION connection: who the production apply job (deploy.yml) is, and the two variables it reads in the GitHub environment `production`. It has the shape of a .thoryn/template.json connection and variable, so .thoryn/ci/login.sh and require-vars.sh read it (THORYN_TEMPLATE_FILE). It is kept out of template.json on purpose: every released thoryn CLI refuses an application template.json with a production connection. When the workspace has a config project, the setup (the Thoryn GitHub App, or `thoryn project init app --config-repo`) reads this file and creates the production trust as the person setting up, pinned to this repository, its GitHub environment `production` and the default branch. It makes the config project the trust's owner and proposes the trust's declaration to the config repository (oauthy ADR 2026-11-03, SSO-4079). Until THORYN_PRODUCTION_WIF_CLIENT_ID and THORYN_PRODUCTION_URL are set on that environment, deploy.yml skips with a notice.

THORYN_PRODUCTION_WIF_CLIENT_ID.description: clientId (wi_...) of this repository's PRODUCTION workload identity trust, pinned to this repository and its GitHub environment `production`. The setup creates the trust and sets this variable; the workspace's config project declares and owns the trust.

THORYN_PRODUCTION_URL.description: The deployed application's https base URL, e.g. https://shop.example.com (no trailing slash). The production client's redirect URIs are <url>/callback and <url>/signed-out.

production.description: Who the production apply job is: the production trust. It creates this application's production client once, under a creation slot a workspace admin approves (oauthy ADR 2026-10-17), owns it, and converges it on every later run. Exactly the application ceiling of oauthy ADR 2026-10-25: no sandbox tool scope, no tenant scope.
